title: Premium Cabin Status Credit in Summit Requalification
content:
**Question: what does premium-cabin flying add to the counted qualifying dollars in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program?**

The coupons the member flew in the last twelve months decide it, as the flown coupons of the member's tickets under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter record the cabin flown.

- At least one coupon flown in the First cabin in that span adds 500 USD.
- Premium coupons in that span flown in Premium Economy only (no First coupon) add 250 USD.
- No premium-cabin coupon in that span adds no premium cabin status credit.

**Question: does the number of First coupons change the credit?** No. One First coupon and ten First coupons both add 500 USD.

**Question: what if the member flew both First and Premium Economy coupons?** A First coupon in the span gives 500 USD; the Premium Economy coupons add nothing further.

**Question: what counts as the last twelve months?** A coupon whose flight date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the tier is set. Hypothetical boundary: on 10 October 2026, a First coupon flown on 11 October 2025 counts and one flown on 10 October 2025 does not.
